title: I Learned the Measure
style: Adult contemporary synth-pop with polished 2010s production, British female lead vocal with clear understated phrasing, midtempo steady pulse, warm analog-style synth pads, rounded bass, restrained electronic drums, crisp piano accents. Begin intimate and conversational, gradually widen into a memorable, emotionally composed chorus; add subtle harmonies and fuller drums in later choruses, then close with a gentle synth-and-vocal resolve. Sophisticated, candid, bittersweet but self-possessed mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A colleague made the introduction
At a City work event in fifteen
Edward John, composed and curious
Asked what I thought, then listened
We found the same small corners
Of a world we both knew well
And month by month the friendship
Took a shape we couldn’t quite name

[Pre-Chorus]
You never asked for more than I had offered
Still, the future gathered in the room

[Chorus]
I tried the shape, I learned the measure
Good intentions couldn’t make it fit
You wanted roads that led to one another
I wanted room to choose the life I lived
No bitter ending, no door slammed behind us
Just a chapter closing, clean and clear
I found the life I meant to build
And I could finally see it here

[Verse 2]
For years we kept each other company
Long enough to test the truth
It wasn’t that the feeling wasn’t real
It was the frame I couldn’t choose
In nineteen, you were engaged so quickly
To someone else, a ready-made way through
We didn’t fight; our messages fell quiet
As the thing between us changed its course

[Pre-Chorus]
Then the wedding ended with the year’s first winter
And news came softly through a friend

[Chorus]
I tried the shape, I learned the measure
Good intentions couldn’t make it fit
You wanted roads that led to one another
I wanted room to choose the life I lived
No bitter ending, no door slammed behind us
Just a chapter closing, clean and clear
I found the life I meant to build
And I could finally see it here

[Bridge]
A table full of friends who know me
A call returned, a key held safe
The ordinary trust between us
Became the home I chose to make
I don’t need to call it loss
To know what those years gave

[Final Chorus]
I tried the shape, I learned the measure
Good intentions couldn’t make it fit
You wanted roads that led to one another
I wanted room to choose the life I lived
No blame to carry, no account to settle
Just a chapter closing, clean and clear
I built a life from chosen circles
And I’m content to meet it here

[Outro]
Edward John, the years made something plain
I knew the life I meant to claim
